name: gcprobe
description: The paths into libc that go through a function pointer, where a link that drops unreachable library code (toolchain/src/ld/fgx_gc.py) could drop too much.  GC Q: qsort calls the program's comparator, which calls strcmp.  GC H: SIGALRM runs a handler installed with signal(3).  GC F: the first run writes /tmp/gc.out without closing it and exits; exit(3) flushes stdio through libc's _lc_flush_hook, and the second run (-r) reads the bytes back.
